claim: The Aurora FAQ says you access Aurora serverless from a client application running in the same VPC and that you can't give a public IP address to Aurora serverless. Clusters created with express configuration are different: they are automatically set up with an internet access gateway, which provides public access to the database with IAM authentication.
question: Can an Aurora serverless cluster be reached from the internet?

qualifiers.condition: except clusters created with express configuration, which get an internet access gateway with IAM authentication

evidence.quote: You access Aurora serverless from within a client application running in the same VPC. You can't give a public IP address to Aurora serverless.
Clusters created with express configuration are automatically set up with an internet access gateway, which provides public access to your database with IAM authentication.

note: Adjudicated 2026-10-13: currency vote unsure because express configuration (2026-03-25) gives public access through an internet access gateway; the exception is now part of the fact. Never use the display without the express-configuration exception.
